verdict.rationale: The only in-product AI evidence is a single community remark that Outlook has a Copilot integration. The same user found it slower than copy-pasting into another client, and nothing describes what insights or suggestions Copilot actually produces from the user's mail. The People API's relevance-based person suggestions are a Graph developer building block, not an in-product insight feature, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of in-product AI insights or suggestions, a description of what Copilot derives from the user's mailbox or calendar data, and independent hands-on confirmation of the quality of its suggestions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: They sometimes miss the Copilot integration, but say copy-pasting into Thunderbird is still faster than using Copilot in Outlook.
